The correct format for a locale string is two lowercase letters indicating the language, followed by an underscore, two uppercase letters indicating the country, anotherunderscore, and then any additional characters. In this case, the third character of the string is an underscore ('_'), which is not allowed according to the defined format.

Based on the test, a locale with an underscore at the third position is possible. In ASCII an underscore has a value greater than "Z". Therefore the IllegalArgumentException occurs.

The input ""fr__POSIX"" in this case contains an underscore as the third and fourth characters. The conditional on line 115 checks, whether the fourth character, saved in variable ""ch3"", is an upper-case letter between ""A"" and ""Z"". Since ""ch3"" is an underscore, the expression ""ch3 > 'Z'"" evaluates to true, and an ""IllegalArgumentException"" is thrown.
